population_by_country: Entity: country-year population measures; Grain: one row per country (country, country_code) with wide columns for each year (year_1960 … year_1997); Notable measures/keys: country, country_code, year_1960…year_1997 (population values by year).
series_summary: Entity: metadata about data series; Grain: one row per series (series_code); Notable measures/keys: series_code, topic, indicator_name, short_definition, long_definition, unit_of_measure, periodicity, base_period, other_notes, aggregation_method, limitations_and_exceptions, notes_from_original_source, general_comments, source, statistical_concept_and_methodology, development_relevance, related_source_links, other_web_links, related_indicators, license_type.
country_series_definitions: Entity: mapping/definition of which series apply to which country; Grain: one row per country_code + series_code pair; Notable measures/keys: country_code, series_code, description.
series_times: Entity: time-related descriptions for series; Grain: one row per series_code + year; Notable measures/keys: series_code, year, description.
country_summary: Entity: country-level metadata and classification; Grain: one row per country (country_code); Notable measures/keys: country_code, short_name, table_name, long_name, two_alpha_code, currency_unit, special_notes, region, income_group, wb_2_code, national_accounts_base_year, national_accounts_reference_year, sna_price_valuation, lending_category, other_groups, system_of_national_accounts, alternative_conversion_factor, ppp_survey_year, balance_of_payments_manual_in_use, external_debt_reporting_status, system_of_trade, government_accounting_concept, imf_data_dissemination_standard, latest_population_census, latest_household_survey, source_of_most_recent_income_and_expenditure_data, vital_registration_complete, latest_agricultural_census, latest_industrial_data, latest_trade_data.
health_nutrition_population: Entity: indicator observations for health/nutrition/population topics; Grain: one row per observation (country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year); Notable measures/keys: country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, value, year.
international_debt: Entity: indicator observations for international debt; Grain: one row per observation (country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year); Notable measures/keys: country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, value, year.
international_education: Entity: indicator observations for international education; Grain: one row per observation (country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year); Notable measures/keys: country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, value, year.
footnotes: Entity: footnote text tied to country-series-year cells; Grain: one row per country_code + series_code + year footnote; Notable measures/keys: country_code, series_code, year, description.
series_time: Entity: time descriptions for series (duplicate of series_times schema); Grain: one row per series_code + year; Notable measures/keys: series_code, year, description.
indicators_data: Entity: generic indicator observations (likely across topics); Grain: one row per observation (country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year); Notable measures/keys: country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, value, year.
